dataset.method: JP Putevi Srbije's Odluka o visini posebne naknade za upotrebu javnog puta, njegovog dela i putnog objekta (putarina), with the Government's consent, as amended in Službeni glasnik RS 120/2025 (applying from 2026-01-01, Vrba from 2026-01-14): the toll in RSD from entry to exit station on each characteristic section, by vehicle category; in force until 2026-01-13. The decision's tables are scans: read by OCR (tools/rs/gazette_ocr.py), each price checked against its mirror cell and category IV against III. Stations placed at OpenStreetMap's toll booths of their name. The Belgrade bypass (category IV per section) is its own table. Held to Putevi Srbije's price list from 2026-01-01 (its RSD amounts, the Internet Archive's copy): the same on every pair it has.
